title: Checkout payments failing with 503
symptoms: Error rate on POST /checkout jumped from 0.2% to 38% within 3 minutes of the 14:05 deploy of payment-api v2.3.1.
error_log: 2026-06-03T14:08:11Z ERROR payment-api sqlalchemy.exc.OperationalError: (psycopg2.OperationalError) FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections
root_cause: Deploy v2.3.1 raised gunicorn workers from 4 to 16 per pod. Each worker opened a pool of 10 connections, exceeding orders-db max_connections=100.
resolution_steps: Roll back payment-api to v2.3.0
Set SQLALCHEMY pool_size=5 and max_overflow=2 per worker
Redeploy with worker count 8
failed_attempts: Restarted payment-api pods; errors returned within 5 minutes
lesson: Before scaling workers, check pods x workers x pool_size against DB max_connections.

title: Order history page timing out
symptoms: GET /orders p99 latency rose from 180ms to 30s during flash sale. Some requests returned 500.
error_log: 2026-06-21T19:32:44Z ERROR orders-api sqlalchemy.exc.TimeoutError: QueuePool limit of size 10 overflow 5 reached, connection timed out, timeout 30.00
root_cause: HPA scaled orders-api from 6 to 20 pods during the flash sale. Total connections exceeded the orders-db limit, so pools blocked waiting for connections.
resolution_steps: Cap orders-api HPA maxReplicas at 10
Route orders-api through PgBouncer in transaction mode
Raise orders-db max_connections from 100 to 200 after checking memory
failed_attempts: Increased pool timeout from 30s to 60s; requests only waited longer
Restarted orders-api pods; issue returned within minutes
lesson: Autoscaling app pods multiplies DB connections. Put PgBouncer in front of shared databases.

title: Stock updates failing after nightly batch job
symptoms: Inventory sync job started at 02:00 and all stock reservation calls started failing with 500.
error_log: 2026-07-09T02:04:19Z ERROR inventory-service psycopg2.OperationalError: connection to server at "orders-db" (10.0.4.12), port 5432 failed: FATAL: sorry, too many clients already
root_cause: Nightly inventory sync job opened one connection per SKU batch without closing them (connection leak in batch loop).
resolution_steps: Kill the inventory sync job
Terminate idle connections with pg_terminate_backend for the sync user
Fix batch loop to use a context manager for connections
Add connection limit for sync user: ALTER ROLE inventory_sync CONNECTION LIMIT 10
failed_attempts: Restarted inventory-service pods; job kept holding connections
lesson: Batch jobs need their own DB role with a connection limit so they cannot starve the live service.

title: Add to cart intermittently failing
symptoms: About 15% of POST /cart/items requests failed with 504. Redis latency graphs showed spikes to 2s.
error_log: 2026-06-10T11:14:02Z ERROR cart-service redis.exceptions.TimeoutError: Timeout reading from redis-cart.shopfast.internal:6379
root_cause: A new analytics feature ran KEYS cart:* on the production Redis every minute, blocking the single-threaded Redis server.
resolution_steps: Disable the analytics feature flag
Replace KEYS with SCAN in the analytics code
Add a Redis ACL rule to block KEYS for app users
failed_attempts: Increased Redis client timeout from 1s to 5s; failures dropped but latency became unacceptable
lesson: Never run KEYS on production Redis. Use SCAN and block KEYS with ACLs.

title: Users logged out and unable to log in
symptoms: Login success rate dropped to 20%. Session lookups timed out. Redis memory at 100%.
error_log: 2026-07-01T08:45:37Z ERROR auth-service redis.exceptions.TimeoutError: Timeout connecting to server redis-session.shopfast.internal:6379; OOM command not allowed when used memory > 'maxmemory'
root_cause: Session keys were written without TTL after a refactor, so the session Redis filled up and hit maxmemory with noeviction policy.
resolution_steps: Set maxmemory-policy to volatile-lru temporarily
Run a SCAN script to add 24h TTL to session keys without one
Fix session write code to always set EX 86400
Add alert on Redis memory above 80%
failed_attempts: Failed over to Redis replica; replica had the same full dataset
lesson: Every cache or session key must have a TTL. Alert on Redis memory before it is full.

title: Product pages slow after cache node replacement
symptoms: Product page p95 rose from 120ms to 4s. Redis timeouts in logs, catalog DB CPU at 95%.
error_log: 2026-07-15T16:22:10Z WARN product-catalog redis.exceptions.TimeoutError: Timeout reading from redis-catalog.shopfast.internal:6379 ; falling back to database
root_cause: Redis cache node was replaced during maintenance with an undersized instance (1 GB instead of 8 GB). Cache hit rate fell from 97% to 30% and fallback load overloaded the catalog DB.
resolution_steps: Resize Redis node back to 8 GB
Warm cache with the top 5000 products script
Add request coalescing so one miss triggers one DB query
failed_attempts: Scaled product-catalog pods from 6 to 12; this increased DB load further
lesson: Redis timeouts plus DB overload usually means a cache stampede. Fix the cache, do not scale the app.

title: All API calls rejected with 401 after key rotation
symptoms: All authenticated endpoints returned 401 Unauthorized starting 10:00. Mobile and web users affected.
error_log: 2026-06-25T10:00:14Z WARN api-gateway jwt.exceptions.InvalidSignatureError: Signature verification failed for kid=2026-06-25
root_cause: Scheduled JWT signing key rotation published the new key to auth-service but api-gateway cached the old JWKS for 24 hours.
resolution_steps: Force api-gateway to refresh JWKS by restarting gateway pods
Reduce JWKS cache TTL to 10 minutes
Publish new signing keys 24h before starting to sign with them
failed_attempts: Rolled back auth-service; tokens signed with the new key were still in circulation
lesson: Key rotation must overlap: publish new key first, sign with it later, keep old key valid until tokens expire.

title: Tokens rejected as expired immediately after login
symptoms: Users on some pods got logged out seconds after login. Error: token expired. Only requests routed to 2 of 8 gateway pods failed.
error_log: 2026-07-04T13:11:52Z WARN api-gateway jwt.exceptions.ExpiredSignatureError: Signature has expired (exp=1783170700, now=1783171012)
root_cause: Two Kubernetes nodes had NTP disabled after an OS image update. Their clocks drifted about 5 minutes ahead, so fresh tokens looked expired.
resolution_steps: Cordon and drain the two drifted nodes
Re-enable chrony on the node image
Add 30s leeway to JWT exp validation
Add clock drift alert per node
failed_attempts: Increased token lifetime from 15 to 60 minutes; the issue remained on drifted nodes
lesson: Token expired errors on a subset of pods point to clock skew. Check node time first.

title: Refresh tokens failing for mobile app
symptoms: Mobile users forced to log in again every 15 minutes. Web users unaffected.
error_log: 2026-07-22T09:30:05Z INFO auth-service POST /token/refresh 401 reason=refresh_token_expired client=mobile-ios issued_ttl=900
root_cause: A config change set REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL to 900 seconds (the access token value) instead of 30 days for the mobile client.
resolution_steps: Revert REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL to 2592000 for mobile client
Add config validation that refresh TTL must exceed access TTL
Add alert on refresh 401 rate
lesson: Validate token TTL config at startup. Refresh TTL must always be greater than access TTL.

title: Search pods restarting repeatedly
symptoms: Search results intermittently empty. search-service pods restarted 40 times in 2 hours.
error_log: 2026-05-28T15:02:33Z kubelet: Container search-service in pod search-service-7d9f8 was OOMKilled (exit code 137), memory limit 1Gi
root_cause: New autocomplete feature cached all query prefixes in an unbounded in-process dict, causing a memory leak.
resolution_steps: Disable autocomplete feature flag
Replace dict with an LRU cache of max 10000 entries
Add memory usage alert at 80% of limit
failed_attempts: Raised memory limit to 2Gi; pods still OOMKilled after 4 hours
lesson: Raising memory limits only delays a leak. Look for unbounded caches.

title: Admin order search extremely slow
symptoms: Admin dashboard order search took 45s. orders-db CPU spiked to 90% whenever admins searched.
error_log: 2026-06-06T10:40:21Z LOG orders-db duration: 44873.112 ms statement: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_email ILIKE '%@gmail.com%' ORDER BY created_at DESC
root_cause: Admin search used leading-wildcard ILIKE on an unindexed column, forcing a full scan of 12M rows.
resolution_steps: Add pg_trgm GIN index on customer_email
Limit admin search results to 100 rows
Route admin queries to the read replica
lesson: Admin tools must use read replicas and indexed queries.

title: Browsers show certificate error on checkout
symptoms: Checkout page blocked by browsers with NET::ERR_CERT_DATE_INVALID. Conversion dropped to zero.
error_log: 2026-06-15T00:00:03Z ERROR ingress-nginx SSL certificate for checkout.shopfast.com expired on 2026-06-15T00:00:00Z
root_cause: cert-manager renewal failed silently for 30 days because the DNS01 solver API token had been revoked.
resolution_steps: Issue new DNS provider API token and update the cert-manager secret
Trigger manual renewal with cmctl renew
Add alert when any certificate expires in less than 14 days
lesson: Alert on certificate expiry date, not only on renewal job status.

title: Order confirmation emails delayed by hours
symptoms: Customers reported confirmation emails arriving 3 hours late. Kafka consumer lag at 450000 messages.
error_log: 2026-06-18T12:00:00Z WARN notification-worker consumer group notif-email lag=451203 topic=order-events partition=0-5
root_cause: Email provider started rate limiting to 10 requests/s after a plan change. The worker retried synchronously, blocking the consumer.
resolution_steps: Upgrade email provider plan
Move retries to a separate retry topic with backoff
Scale consumers to match the 6 partitions
failed_attempts: Restarted consumers; lag kept growing
lesson: Never retry synchronously inside a Kafka consumer loop. Use a retry topic.

title: Product images missing on homepage
symptoms: Homepage showed broken image icons for about 30% of products after a bucket policy change.
error_log: 2026-06-23T14:12:45Z ERROR image-service botocore.exceptions.ClientError: An error occurred (AccessDenied) when calling the GetObject operation: Access Denied
root_cause: A Terraform change replaced the image bucket policy and removed read access for the image-service IAM role.
resolution_steps: Revert the Terraform bucket policy change
Add s3:GetObject for image-service role scoped to the images/ prefix
Add a Terraform plan check that flags policy removals
lesson: Review IAM and bucket policy diffs in Terraform plans carefully. Scope permissions to the prefix.

title: Orders failing with DNS resolution errors
symptoms: About 10% of calls from orders-api to inventory-service failed. Errors spread across all pods.
error_log: 2026-06-28T17:21:09Z ERROR orders-api httpx.ConnectError: [Errno -3] Temporary failure in name resolution: inventory-service.shopfast.svc.cluster.local
root_cause: CoreDNS was running 2 replicas and hit CPU throttling under peak load, dropping DNS queries.
resolution_steps: Scale CoreDNS to 4 replicas
Raise CoreDNS CPU limit
Enable NodeLocal DNSCache
failed_attempts: Restarted orders-api pods; errors continued
lesson: Intermittent name resolution failures across pods usually mean CoreDNS is overloaded.

title: Stock reservations failing with deadlock errors
symptoms: During peak hours 5% of reservations failed. Orders for popular items could not complete.
error_log: 2026-07-02T20:15:33Z ERROR inventory-service psycopg2.errors.DeadlockDetected: deadlock detected DETAIL: Process 4211 waits for ShareLock on transaction 99812; blocked by process 4219.
root_cause: Multi-item reservations locked product rows in cart order rather than a consistent order, causing deadlocks between concurrent orders.
resolution_steps: Sort product IDs before locking rows with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE
Add retry with jitter on DeadlockDetected
Add deadlock count metric
lesson: Always lock rows in a consistent order in multi-row transactions.

title: Weekend discount started 5.5 hours early
symptoms: A 40% discount code went live Friday 18:30 instead of Saturday 00:00 local time.
error_log: 2026-07-05T18:30:00Z INFO promotions-service activated promotion WEEKEND40 start=2026-07-06T00:00:00 (naive, interpreted as UTC)
root_cause: Promotion start time was stored as a naive datetime and interpreted as UTC instead of IST.
resolution_steps: Deactivate WEEKEND40 until correct start
Store all promotion times as timezone-aware UTC
Show timezone explicitly in the admin UI
lesson: Never store naive datetimes. Convert to UTC at input time.

title: Search returning partial results
symptoms: Search results missing about half the catalog. Elasticsearch cluster health yellow then red.
error_log: 2026-07-11T07:44:18Z WARN elasticsearch cluster health status changed from [YELLOW] to [RED]; reason: [shards unassigned] disk watermark [95%] exceeded on node es-data-2
root_cause: Old daily log indices were never deleted and filled the data node disk, so Elasticsearch stopped allocating shards.
resolution_steps: Delete log indices older than 14 days
Add an ILM policy to delete indices after 14 days
Move logs to a separate cluster from product search
lesson: Add retention policies for every time-based index. Keep logs away from customer-facing search.

title: Checkout button hidden for all users
symptoms: Checkout button not rendered. Frontend console shows feature flag undefined.
error_log: 2026-07-13T12:02:11Z ERROR checkout-web TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'enabled') at CheckoutButton (flags.newCheckout)
root_cause: Feature flag was renamed from new_checkout to newCheckout in the flag service but not in the frontend code.
resolution_steps: Restore the old flag name as an alias
Add a default value for missing flags in the frontend
Add a CI check that referenced flags exist
lesson: Code must handle missing flags with safe defaults.

title: Pods evicted during peak traffic
symptoms: orders-api pods evicted repeatedly. Nodes reported DiskPressure.
error_log: 2026-07-14T18:40:02Z kubelet: Evicted pod orders-api-5c7b9: The node was low on resource: ephemeral-storage. Container orders-api was using 9Gi.
root_cause: Debug logging was left enabled in production and wrote about 9 GB of logs to the container filesystem.
resolution_steps: Set LOG_LEVEL=INFO
Set ephemeral-storage limits on orders-api pods
Configure log rotation at the container runtime
lesson: Debug logging in production can fill node disks. Set ephemeral storage limits.

title: Customers received duplicate shipping emails
symptoms: Some customers received the same shipping email 5 to 8 times.
error_log: 2026-07-18T06:00:12Z INFO notification-worker cron send_shipping_updates started on pod notification-worker-2 (another run already active on notification-worker-0)
root_cause: The shipping email cron ran in every worker replica after scaling from 1 to 8 pods, and there was no idempotency key.
resolution_steps: Move the cron into a single Kubernetes CronJob
Add idempotency key per order and email type
Add a Redis lock for the job run
lesson: Scheduled jobs inside app replicas run once per replica. Use a CronJob and idempotency keys.

title: Shipping labels not generated
symptoms: Warehouse could not print labels. Label requests failed with 429 from the courier API.
error_log: 2026-07-20T10:15:42Z ERROR shipping-service courier_api HTTP 429 Too Many Requests; Retry-After: 60; retry storm detected 1200 req/min
root_cause: Retries without backoff after a brief courier outage caused a retry storm, triggering the courier's rate limit.
resolution_steps: Pause the label queue for 2 minutes
Add exponential backoff with jitter and respect Retry-After
Add a circuit breaker around the courier client
failed_attempts: Scaled shipping-service to more pods; this increased the retry rate
lesson: Retries without backoff turn a small outage into a big one.

title: Prices showing old values after update
symptoms: Price changes in admin took up to 6 hours to appear on product pages.
error_log: 2026-07-24T09:05:00Z INFO product-catalog cache HIT product:88213 ttl_remaining=21540s price=1299 (db price=999)
root_cause: Price updates did not invalidate the product cache, and cache TTL was 6 hours.
resolution_steps: Delete cache key on price update
Lower product cache TTL to 10 minutes
Publish a price-changed event for other caches
lesson: Any write path must invalidate the cache for the data it changes.

title: Site down after gateway config deploy
symptoms: All routes returned 502 immediately after gateway config deploy at 16:00.
error_log: 2026-07-26T16:00:41Z ERROR api-gateway upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers. reset reason: connection failure, upstream: orders-api:8080 (config expects port 8000)
root_cause: Gateway config deploy changed all upstream ports from 8080 to 8000 by mistake in a templating change.
resolution_steps: Roll back gateway config to previous version
Add a canary step for gateway config deploys
Add a config test that checks upstream ports against service definitions
lesson: Gateway config is production code. Deploy it with canary and tests.

title: Product reviews not loading
symptoms: Reviews section empty on product pages. reviews-service health check passing.
error_log: 2026-07-29T13:44:30Z ERROR reviews-service pymongo.errors.ServerSelectionTimeoutError: reviews-mongo-0:27017: [Errno 111] Connection refused, Timeout: 30s
root_cause: MongoDB primary was stepped down during a version upgrade and the client connection string listed only one host, so the client never found the new primary.
resolution_steps: Update connection string to include all replica set members with replicaSet=rs0
Make health check verify the DB connection
Run upgrades one member at a time
failed_attempts: Restarted reviews-service; it still pointed only at reviews-mongo-0
lesson: Always use a full replica set connection string. Health checks must test dependencies.

title: Checkout rejected by payment provider after credential rotation
symptoms: All checkout attempts started failing with provider authentication errors immediately after the secrets rotation job completed.
error_log: 2026-08-02T09:14:20Z ERROR payment-api httpx.HTTPStatusError: payment provider returned 401 invalid_api_key for merchant shopfast-prod
root_cause: The rotation job updated the provider key in the secret manager but payment-api kept using the old value because its secret mount was not refreshed.
resolution_steps: Refresh the payment-api secret mount
Verify the active merchant key with a non-capturing provider health check
Restart only the payment-api workers after confirming the new key is loaded
failed_attempts: Retried failed charges without refreshing the credential
lesson: After rotating provider credentials, verify the running workload loaded the new secret before retrying transactions.

title: Checkout blocked by inventory reservation conflicts
symptoms: Orders for popular products failed with conflict responses even though the warehouse dashboard showed units available.
error_log: 2026-08-04T14:33:09Z ERROR inventory-service ReservationConflict: requested quantity exceeds available stock after stale inventory snapshot
root_cause: A delayed warehouse feed left reservations out of sync with the authoritative stock ledger after a bulk import.
resolution_steps: Pause new reservations for affected SKUs
Reconcile reservation rows against the warehouse stock ledger
Replay the delayed inventory feed and verify available quantities
failed_attempts: Raised checkout retry counts; retries created more conflicting reservations
lesson: Resolve reservation conflicts from the authoritative stock ledger; blind retries can amplify overselling.

title: Shipping labels unavailable during carrier outage
symptoms: Paid orders queued for fulfillment because label creation repeatedly failed against the primary carrier API.
error_log: 2026-08-07T16:52:41Z ERROR shipping-service httpx.HTTPStatusError: carrier API returned 503 label creation unavailable after 3 retries
root_cause: The primary carrier had a regional outage, while the configured secondary carrier was healthy but not enabled for automatic failover.
resolution_steps: Route new label requests to the secondary carrier
Keep failed label jobs queued with their idempotency keys
Reconcile queued jobs after the primary carrier recovers
failed_attempts: Repeated requests to the unavailable carrier without backoff
lesson: Use a tested carrier failover path and preserve idempotency when replaying queued label jobs.

title: Payment authorization fails with invalid merchant key
symptoms: Checkout returned gateway errors for every card type; the provider dashboard showed rejected API authentication.
error_log: 2026-08-12T11:06:31Z ERROR payment-api httpx.HTTPStatusError: payment provider returned 401 invalid_api_key for merchant shopfast-prod
root_cause: A deployment referenced the staging payment secret in production after a secret alias was renamed.
resolution_steps: Restore the production secret alias
Refresh payment-api credentials from the secret manager
Run a provider authorization check before reopening checkout traffic
failed_attempts: Rolled back application code without correcting the secret alias
lesson: Validate secret names and environment scope during deployment; a code rollback does not repair a misbound production secret.

title: Oversell protection rejecting valid inventory reservations
symptoms: Reservation conflicts increased after the nightly warehouse import, affecting several high-volume SKUs with positive stock counts.
error_log: 2026-08-15T02:19:54Z ERROR inventory-service ReservationConflict: requested quantity exceeds available stock after stale inventory snapshot
root_cause: The import updated available stock but did not clear stale holds left by a timed-out reservation worker.
resolution_steps: Identify and expire orphaned holds
Reconcile reservations against the warehouse stock ledger
Restart the timed-out worker after confirming its lease was released
failed_attempts: Manually increased available stock without reconciling active holds
lesson: Inventory counts and reservation holds must be reconciled together before changing stock availability.

title: Carrier outage stopped order fulfillment
symptoms: Fulfillment workers accumulated label jobs and carrier requests returned 503 across multiple regions.
error_log: 2026-08-19T07:41:12Z ERROR shipping-service httpx.HTTPStatusError: carrier API returned 503 label creation unavailable after 3 retries
root_cause: A carrier-side outage affected the primary endpoint, and shipping-service did not fail over to the secondary provider.
resolution_steps: Enable secondary-carrier routing
Apply bounded exponential backoff to queued label requests
Verify label creation and deduplicate any replayed jobs
failed_attempts: Scaled shipping workers while every worker continued calling the unhealthy carrier
lesson: Scale only after routing around a provider outage; otherwise more workers increase pressure on the failing dependency.
